Browser (local): seller sidebar signed in as the seeded seller, light and dark, 390/768/1280 px, three routes: all 18 per-link style digests (box, fill, text colour, borders, padding, white-space, weight) identical to a capture on main taken before the change; exactly one aria-current=page per list; at 390 px the Orders tab still scrolls into the strip (scrollLeft 129 as before); real Tab shows the inset 2 px ring on all five links in both themes; Enter on a focused link navigates without a page reload. Admin: the real Sidebar on a temporary page (deleted afterwards), not in a signed-in admin session: with no matching route all 15 links in the desktop list and in the opened mobile panel are identical to the baseline in light and dark and carry no aria-current, and a link click closes the mobile panel. description: app/seller/dashboard/products/[id]/edit/image-manager.tsx line 283-318: label acts as drag-and-drop upload zone containing hidden file input (one-off dropzone; no @bomy/ui primitive (candidate for a FileDropzone))
evidence: PR 5d-12: the upload drop zone in apps/web/src/app/seller/dashboard/products/[id]/edit/image-manager.tsx is now the shared FileDropzone (packages/ui/src/components/file-dropzone.tsx, @bomy/ui/file-dropzone; D24). It owns the drag state, the dashed box and the file input; the file checks (image type, 2 MB), the upload and the toasts stay in image-manager. The input was display:none, so a keyboard user could not reach it; it is now visually hidden (sr-only) and stays in the Tab order (D25). It has the accessible name Add product image and is described by the hint under the grid (D27). The input value is cleared right after a file is handed over, so choosing the same invalid file again now fires change (D26, accepted behaviour change). The scanner exceptions R1-input and R1-label for this file were removed because they no longer match. Proof: tests/components/file-dropzone.test.tsx (the shared piece) and tests/seller-dashboard/image-manager.test.tsx (baselines written first on the old markup and mutation-checked: drag counter reset, uploading guard on drop, the 2 MB limit, the accept attribute; only the display:none test was flipped). Browser (local, signed in as the seeded seller): on one product of the seeded seller, light and dark, 1280 and 390 px: the upload box in four states (idle, drag-over, uploading, after a failed upload) has the same style digest (box, border, fills, colours, radius, icon, text, bar) as a capture taken on main before the change, with drag states made by synthetic drag events and the storage PUT held then aborted so no image was written. Before the change a full real Tab cycle (54 stops) never reached the upload input. After it, Tab reaches the input (stop 27, after Add Variant) in both themes; it shows a 2 px ring with a 2 px offset (ring colour against the page background 4.56:1 light and 5.46:1 dark, calculated from the computed colours); Enter and Space each open the file chooser; a file chosen in that chooser starts the upload (the storage PUT was attempted and aborted by the test); after a mouse click the input has focus but no ring. Not evaluated: a completed upload in the browser (covered by the jsdom tests only), a real file drag from the desktop, a screen reader, Firefox, Safari, touch.
